metadata.name: Glow Rocker
metadata.description: A raymarched 3D rocker switch that tips on its hinge, flips the whole scene from soft grey daylight to black, and spills violet light from under its lifted edge. Click it or press Space to rock it, and pick a camera view.
metadata.author: louisstudios
